order_book: Further considering the strong demand visibility, healthy order books, and existing capacity utilizations now nearing their peak, our board has approved an additional capex of Rs.500 crores.
Ashish Garg: So right now, we have roughly 50% of the order books that we have in hand is from the export sector.
guidance: At the beginning of the year, we were optimistic about the business outlook for FY27, supported by improving demand conditions across our key end-user segments and good visibility on incremental business opportunities.
These discussions are progressing well, and we expect them to translate into orders in early FY2028.
capex: On the capacity front, our installed capacity forging capacity stands at 1,58,000 metric tons, while our machining capacity stands at 82,000 metric tons.
During H1 FY2027, capacity utilization stood at 60% in forging and 77% in machining.
risks: These statements are not the guarantee of future performance of the company, and it may involve risks and uncertainties that are difficult to predict.
We have been able to sustain profitability levels at or above those achieved in FY2026, despite an increase in raw material prices and other cost pressures.
focus: This has enabled us to deliver profitability growth ahead of revenue growth, reflecting the strength of our diversified business portfolio, increasing value addition, and our continued focus on operational excellence.
We continue to focus on improving the quality of our product mix with an increasing emphasis on higher value-added machining operations.

The proposed investment will primarily focus on our expanding machining capabilities while supplementing our existing forging capabilities and will be best suited to growing requirements of our customers.
